haikus.haiku:
Melted honey swirls
Soft steam curls, sweet warm corn scent
Pudding dreams melt bright
Happy #NationalIndianPuddingDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Gentle hands share light
Soft smiles bloom like rain in town
Kindness grows warm hearts
Happy #WorldKindnessDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Ink spills on paper
Gilded quill writes tales bright new
Joyful candles glow
#HappyBirthdayRobertLouisStevenson from @ClamBakeSanta
